children: Odyssey Therapeutics reported positive Phase 2a OD-001 results and a $433 million cash balance expected to fund operations into H2 2028.
Posted corporate presentation (Sept 8, 2026) disclosing Phase 2a monotherapy data for OD-001 and program pipeline updates.
OD-001 Phase 2a (n=49 completers) met primary MMCS endpoint (consolidated change -2.6, p<0.001) with meaningful clinical remission rates.
OD-001 was well tolerated at 10 mg BID and 20 mg BID; no drug-related SAEs and low discontinuation through 12 weeks.
Company reports $433 million cash as of June 30, 2026, expected to fund operations into H2 2028.
Clinical milestones planned: OD-001 combination and Phase 2b readouts in H2 2027; OD-002 CTA filing H2 2026 and Phase 1/2 start H1 2027.
